svg.title: Defects and cures spindle parts (example)
svg.text: Typical defects of spindle parts – what you see, cause, how it is found, cure
The six defects of the twin's fault chips + the most common workshop defects (limits = twin example values)
zones after nital etch; MBN peak
too much infeed, no coolant in the gap
sharp CBN, Q′_w limit, coolant jet ≈ v_s,
as burn; check stock after heat treatment,
waves on the seat, 15–30 UPR, roundness
balance + dress the wheel, change n_w,
residual stress from turning, no stress
relief, shaft lying in the furnace
V-blocks + dial at the seats after
blue only at the large or small end,
blue test with plug gauge, two-diameter
set α/2 = 2.862° with sine bar (4.994 mm),
short stiff quill, dress before last pass
blue only at the left end = angle wrong
good: ≥ 80 % spread over the full length
thread finished on an unground Ø or
gauge nut with ground face + dial
finish the thread on the ground seats
tilted nut face = bearing inner rings tilt
Bore drift (Op 40) → uneven wall, unbalance → UT wall gauge → counter-rotation, bushing aligned ≤ 0.01 mm, UT-tested bar
White layer left · NHD too low → coupon / stock records → stock 0.03 mm per side, deeper nitriding target (Cpk!)
Burrs / chips in the bore, corrosion, dents → endoscope, cleanliness test, visual → deburring, washing, VCI, V-boxes / hanging
chapter 27 · fault chips of the twin
Values = twin example values · not to scale · 2026-11
